decision: for the adjuster -- this referral states no coverage decision
summary: FACTS: Claimant reports 5 cm of rainwater ran off a field behind the home, across the back garden and under patio doors, covering kitchen and family room floors on 7 July 2026. Loss date 2026‑07‑07. Policy HH‑2024‑00031 was in force on that date under endorsement set HEND‑2025. WORDING TO CHECK: HX‑3 – "Flood, inundation and surface water are governed solely by the flood endorsement in the endorsement set attached to the period of insurance in which the loss happened." HFL‑25 §1 – "In this endorsement, flood means water from any source outside your home that covers normally dry ground. Flood includes rivers and streams bursting their banks, the sea and storm surge, and surface water from heavy rain or rainfall that collects on the ground or runs off roads, gardens and fields into your home." HFL‑25 §2.1 – "We do not insure loss or damage caused by flood, including surface water from heavy rainfall, rising rivers and storm surge, unless Flood Plus is shown on your schedule. This applies to your buildings and your contents, and whether or not a storm happened at the same time." HFL‑25 §2.2 – "If your schedule shows Flood Plus, we insure flood damage to your buildings and contents up to the Flood Plus sub‑limit in the 2025 Schedule of Sub‑limits (HSL‑25), after the flood deductible in §2.3. Flood Plus is not available where your home is in a designated flood zone." FOR THE ADJUSTER: confirm that the water source was rain runoff from the field, not from a river or sea; confirm that the loss date falls within the term 2025‑07‑25 to 2026‑07‑24; confirm that the policy schedule does not list Flood Plus; confirm that the claimant’s home is not in a designated flood zone; confirm the deductible of £1,000 and policy limit of £600,000 for buildings; note that no sub‑limit applies. No coverage decision is provided; the adjuster should review these facts and wording to determine the claim outcome.
